# KernelBench's fuzzer varied only tensor values, and some functions barely change under random inputs, so wrong kernels were graded correct; human-verified extra tests put the overestimate at about 31 points.

## Relations
from:: [[2507.02825 - Agentic Benchmark Checklist (ABC)]]
supports:: [[CLM - Deterministic graders fail silently when their scope drifts from the spec]]

## Quote
> If every generated input makes ReLU output zero, a kernel that always returns zero passes. KernelBench had functions like `mean(softmax(x))` that barely change under uniform random inputs, so a wrong kernel looks right.

## Setup
KernelBench level-1 kernels generated by Lange et al. (Sakana AI); o3-mini-written pytest cases, human-verified.
